mina: Onboarding nebula-6b (converted from Mistral layout). After int4 we see weird punctuation spacing and occasional token drops in summaries. Any quick triage tips?
oscar: Check rotary per-head scales and tokenizer special token indices early. Also run an attention-variance probe.
mina: Baseline vs quant: float32 ROUGE-L 44.0, int4 37.5. Sample: ref="Final result: success." hyp="Final result : success ."
tara: That spacing often means tokenization differences (NFKC vs NFC) or added sentinel id in front of bos. Dump tokenizer.special_tokens_map and compare text->ids with our tokenizer.
mina: Tokenizer looks OK, but converter log shows it collapsed `rotary.rescale_per_head=true` -> collapsed to scalar.
oscar: Bingo. Collapsing per-head scales breaks head dynamics; quant amplifies it. Patch the converter to preserve per-head multipliers, then re-run symmetric int4 quant.
mina: Reconverted with --preserve-per-head-rotary and quant symmetric. Kicked CI quick-eval (100 examples).
ci-bot: started run 12099 (nebula-6b int4 quick-eval)
(8m later)
mina: New int4 ROUGE-L 43.2. Spacing fixed. Remaining ~0.8 gap likely from quant noise. I'll open PR with converter fix, a 100-example smoke test, and a small attn-variance check to catch head collapse.
